endpoints.name: Reconfirm an existing user to a company
endpoints.summary: Resend a confirmation to an existing user by id (the /reconfirm endpoint); use to re-trigger confirmation rather than a fresh invite (mutating).

endpoints.name: Performs bulk actions on an array of users
endpoints.summary: Apply a batch action across many user ids at once; use for multi-user operations instead of single-user calls (mutating).

endpoints.name: Gets a new blank User object
endpoints.summary: Fetch a blank user with default values; use to pre-populate a new-user form before calling store.

endpoints.name: List vendors
endpoints.summary: List or filter many vendors with search, sort, and pagination; use when browsing or finding vendors rather than fetching one by id.

endpoints.name: Create vendor
endpoints.summary: Create a new vendor (name required) with address and contacts; use when adding a vendor, not when editing an existing one (mutating).

endpoints.name: Delete vendor
endpoints.summary: Archive/soft-delete one vendor by id; use to remove a single vendor rather than batch-deleting many (mutating).

endpoints.name: Show vendor
endpoints.summary: Fetch one vendor by its hashed id; use when you already know the id and need that single vendor's details.

endpoints.name: Update vendor
endpoints.summary: Modify an existing vendor by id with new field values; use to change a vendor you already have, not to create one (mutating).

endpoints.name: Edit vendor
endpoints.summary: Fetch one vendor by id prepared for editing; use to load current values before an update, not to perform the update itself.

endpoints.name: Uploads a vendor document
endpoints.summary: Attach one or more documents/files to a vendor by id via multipart upload; use to add attachments, not to edit vendor fields (mutating).

endpoints.name: Bulk vendor actions
endpoints.summary: Apply a batch action across many vendor ids in one call; use for mass archive/restore/delete instead of acting on one record (mutating).

endpoints.name: Blank vendor
endpoints.summary: Fetch a blank vendor with default values; use to prefill a new-record form before calling store_vendor.

endpoints.name: Executes the task scheduler via a webcron service
endpoints.summary: Call to trigger execution of the task scheduler as a webcron tick, running due scheduled jobs now rather than just reading status.

endpoints.name: Gets a list of Webhooks
endpoints.summary: List or filter many webhooks with pagination, sorting, and includes when browsing or searching configured webhook subscriptions.

endpoints.name: Adds a Webhook
endpoints.summary: Create a new webhook subscription for the company when registering an endpoint to receive event callbacks (mutating).

endpoints.name: Deletes a Webhook
endpoints.summary: Call to archive/soft-delete one existing webhook subscription by its hashed id; use list/show to inspect webhooks instead (mutating).

endpoints.name: Shows a Webhook
endpoints.summary: Fetch one webhook by its hashed id when you know the id and need that single subscription's details.

endpoints.name: Updates a Webhook
endpoints.summary: Modify an existing webhook by its hashed id to change its target URL or event triggers (mutating).

endpoints.name: Shows a Webhook for editting
endpoints.summary: Fetch one webhook by id prepared for an edit form (read-only); use update_webhook to actually save changes.

endpoints.name: Performs bulk actions on an array of Webhooks
endpoints.summary: Run a batch action over an array of webhook ids at once when archiving or restoring many subscriptions together (mutating).

endpoints.name: Gets a new blank Webhook object
endpoints.summary: Fetch a blank webhook template with default values to prefill a new-webhook form (read-only); use store_webhook to create it.

endpoints.name: Yodlee Webhook
endpoints.summary: Call as the Yodlee bank-feed callback to notify the system that linked financial data is ready to refresh; not for normal data fetches (mutating).
